# Third-party sources

`vorbis` and `oggvorbis` are jfreymuth/vorbis v1.0.2 and
jfreymuth/oggvorbis v1.0.5 with safety and correctness patches, copied from
[zenibako/butterscotch-pocket](https://github.com/zenibako/butterscotch-pocket)
`third_party/` at commit `64594ef`. Each keeps its upstream MIT license in
`LICENSE` and describes its patches in `PATCHES.md`.
